Occurrences.Kwic: 樊噲怒。曰：恁麼則今日得遇和尚也。師曰：仰面看天不見天。問：德山棒，臨濟喝，直至如今，少人拈掇。請師拈掇。師曰：千鈞之弩，不為鼷鼠而發機。曰：作家宗師，今朝有在。師便喝。僧禮拜。師曰：五湖衲子，一錫禪人。未到同安，不妨疑著。上堂：橫吞巨海，倒卓須彌。衲僧面前，也是尋常茶飯。行脚人須是荊棘林內坐大道場，向和泥合水處認取本來面目。且作麼生見得？遂拈拄杖曰：直饒見得，未免山僧拄杖

Occurrences.Kwic: 衫子出青州，句中若得真消息，動地驚天出眾流。庭前柏樹子二頌庭前柏樹子二頌趙老庭前柏樹子，蒼蒼自古蔭禪林，參天踞地無人會，摘葉尋枝直到今。庭前古柏翠幽幽，直指禪人當下休，無限婆心何太切，五湖衲子豁雙眸。東山水上行頌東山水上行頌雲門拈出無生句，諸佛分明絕覆藏，無柰衲僧猶不薦，東山水上亂商量。因徑山容和尚垂問文殊是七佛之師因…因徑山容和尚垂問：「文殊是七佛之師，因甚出女子定不得？

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Patch-robed monks of the five lakes is a collective address for itinerant Chan monks drawn from across the realm.
EvidenceBody: Speakers summon them with the parallel 'high-stream people of the four seas' and ask them to discern a case. Tong'an Changcha uses the phrase in telling an arriving monk that those who have not reached Tong'an may still harbor doubt.
Verses and hall addresses also picture conversation with this traveling community, preserving the human collective rather than turning the five lakes into literal provenance.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: A geographic total becomes a public name for the mobile audience that carries questions and sayings between Chan seats.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: It does not assert that every named monk literally came from one of five lakes; the phrase functions as a realm-wide collective.

ComparedThings: patch-robed monks of the five lakes
its attested grammatical and rhetorical deployments
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Vocative, subject, and verse grammar all refer to the same wandering Chan collective.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Five lakes, everywhere, wandering, monks, and patch-robes expose both the image and its audience.

ModifierControls.Finding: Parallel use with the four seas establishes realm-wide scope rather than five biographical origins.

FamilyControls.Finding: The dominant parallel collective, retained separately.
